chunks: And it is narrated: “He was embalmed with a mithqal of musk in addition to camphor.”

key_terms.الْكَافُورِ: camphor, a substance used in preparing the deceased
key_terms.بِمِثْقَالِ: with a mithqal, a known unit of weight
key_terms.حُنِّطَ: was embalmed or prepared with funeral perfume

ai.seo_question: What is narrated about the embalming substances used for the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم?
ai.summary: This report states that the embalming of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم included a mithqal of musk in addition to camphor. It indicates a funerary practice connected to honoring the deceased and is relevant in discussions of rites concerning the dead.
